faqs.question: Can I create an account for free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Creating an account does not require a credit card. A credit balance is needed to run paid AI jobs.

faqs.question: How are credits used?
faqs.answer: Each enabled AI feature shows its credit cost before you submit a job. Credits are reserved when a job starts and eligible credits are returned if it fails.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Monthly, Yearly, and One-Time plans?
faqs.answer: Monthly plans add credits each billing cycle. Yearly plans are billed annually and add credits monthly. One-time credit packs do not renew.

faqs.question: Do unused credits expire?
faqs.answer: Purchased credits do not expire. Subscription credits refresh each grant period and are available while the plan remains active.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can cancel a Monthly or Yearly plan at any time. The plan remains active until the end of the paid billing period.

faqs.question: What happens when I use all my credits?
faqs.answer: You can buy a one-time credit pack or choose a recurring plan. Jobs that cost more than your available balance cannot start.

sections.title: Scope of This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy describes how MP3ToText ("we", "us", or "our") handles personal information when you use our website, API, and related services.

This includes when you create or use an account, upload audio or video, submit media links, generate transcripts or AI outputs, contact support, purchase paid features, or otherwise interact with the Service.

This Privacy Policy does not apply to third-party websites, applications, products, or services that may be linked from or integrated with the Service. Those third parties are governed by their own privacy policies.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect personal information in the categories below.
items: Account and identity information, such as email address, authentication identifiers, account settings, and subscription status.
Guest and session information, such as anonymous session identifiers, browser or device tokens, local storage values, and usage limits applied to unauthenticated use.

Content you submit, including uploaded audio, video, transcript source files, submitted media links, file names, file types, file sizes, durations, language metadata, prompts, instructions, templates, transcripts, summaries, mind maps, subtitles, user edits, and exported outputs.

Payment and transaction information, such as plan type, billing status, purchase history, invoice records, transaction identifiers, and limited payment-related metadata provided by payment processors. We do not store full payment card numbers on our servers.
Device, usage, and log information, such as IP address, browser type, device type, operating system, language settings, referring URLs, timestamps, feature usage, diagnostics, and security events.
Communications and support information, such as emails, support tickets, and other messages you send to us.
Cookie and similar technology data used for authentication, security, preferences, and Service functionality.

sections.title: How We Collect Information
paragraphs: We collect information directly from you when you create an account, upload files, submit media links, purchase a plan, generate outputs, communicate with us, or otherwise use the Service.

We also collect information automatically when you use the Service and may receive information from third-party service providers that help us operate the Service, such as authentication, payment, infrastructure, communications, and AI processing vendors.

sections.title: How We Use Information
items: Provide, operate, maintain, and improve the Service.

Authenticate users, manage accounts, and enforce usage limits for guest and registered use.
Deliver paid features, subscriptions, transcription minutes, invoices, and downloads.

sections.title: Anonymous and Guest Use
paragraphs: Certain features may be available without creating an account. When you use the Service as a guest, we may use cookies, anonymous session identifiers, browser storage, or similar mechanisms to deliver transcription results during your active session, apply free-tier limits, and protect the Service from abuse.

Guest transcription content—including uploaded media, transcripts, summaries, mind maps, and related outputs—is processed only to provide the Service you request. We do not retain guest transcription content for long-term storage, account history, marketing, or model training. Guest content is deleted after processing is complete and the applicable guest session ends, except for minimal technical logs retained for security, abuse prevention, and legal compliance as described in this Policy.

If you clear browser data, close your session, or lose access to a guest result link or token, you may no longer be able to retrieve prior guest outputs. Create an account if you need persistent access to your work.

sections.title: Media Links and Third-Party Content
paragraphs: If you submit a link to audio or video hosted on a third-party platform, we may resolve, retrieve, or process that link and related metadata so we can transcribe the underlying media.

You are responsible for ensuring that you have the rights and permissions needed to submit, access, and transcribe that content. Third-party platforms may impose their own terms, restrictions, and privacy practices, which we do not control.

sections.title: AI Processing and Generated Content
paragraphs: A core part of the Service involves processing media and text through automated systems and authorized third-party AI, speech-to-text, or language service providers acting on our instructions.

When you use features such as transcription, summary generation, mind map generation, subtitle generation, or similar tools, your submitted content and related instructions may be processed by our systems and approved service providers solely to generate the outputs you request.

Unless we are required by law or you provide separate consent, we do not use your uploaded content to train general-purpose artificial intelligence models for public or commercial reuse. Our service providers process content under contractual restrictions appropriate to the Service.
Generated outputs may contain errors, omissions, inaccurate interpretations, or formatting issues. You are responsible for reviewing and validating outputs before relying on them.

sections.title: Legal Bases for Processing (EEA/UK Users)
paragraphs: If you are located in the European Economic Area, Switzerland, or the United Kingdom, we process personal information under one or more of the following legal bases.
items: Contract, where processing is necessary to provide the Service you requested, including guest processing, account creation, media processing, output generation, billing, and support.
Legitimate interests, where necessary for service improvement, fraud prevention, security, abuse detection, and business operations, provided those interests are not overridden by your rights.
Consent, where required by applicable law, such as for optional marketing communications.
Legal obligation, where processing is necessary to comply with applicable law, regulation, court order, or lawful request.

paragraphs: We use carefully selected service providers to help us operate the Service. These providers may process personal information on our behalf only for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy and subject to appropriate contractual safeguards.

Depending on the features you use, processing may involve providers in categories such as cloud storage, content delivery, authentication, payment processing, email delivery, speech-to-text or AI inference, and security monitoring. We may update providers over time as the Service evolves.

sections.title: International Data Transfers
paragraphs: We may process and store information in countries other than the one where you reside. Those countries may have data protection laws that differ from those in your jurisdiction.

Where required by applicable law, we take appropriate measures to protect cross-border data transfers, which may include contractual safeguards, vendor due diligence, and other legally recognized transfer mechanisms.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, including to provide the Service, maintain security, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.

Guest transcription content is not retained for long-term storage. It is deleted after processing is complete and the applicable guest session ends, except for limited security, diagnostic, or compliance logs that do not include the full content of your uploads where feasible.

For registered accounts, uploaded files and generated outputs may be retained while your account is active and for a reasonable period afterward so you can access history, receive support, recover from errors, prevent abuse, or meet legal obligations. You may request deletion of account-associated data by contacting support@mp3totext.io, subject to applicable law and operational requirements.
Billing and transaction records may be retained for tax, accounting, audit, and compliance purposes. Logs and diagnostics may be retained for limited periods for security and reliability purposes.

sections.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies
paragraphs: We use cookies and similar technologies that are necessary to operate the Service, keep users signed in, maintain sessions, secure accounts, apply guest usage limits, remember preferences, and prevent abuse.

MP3ToText does not currently provide a separate cookie consent banner or preference center. Where cookies are not strictly necessary for the Service to function, you may limit them through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies or storage may affect sign-in, guest transcription access, or other functionality.

sections.title: Data Security
paragraphs: We implement reasonable technical, administrative, and organizational measures designed to protect personal information from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, disclosure, alteration, and destruction.

These measures may include access controls, encryption in transit, encryption at rest where supported by our infrastructure, secure storage practices, logging, least-privilege permissions, and vendor management processes. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

audioRecorderPrivacy.description: This policy explains how Voice & Tab Audio Recorder handles microphone audio, browser tab audio, local recordings, downloads, and optional transcription.

legalSummary.title: Privacy at a Glance
items: Recording starts only after you choose a recording mode.
Microphone and browser tab audio are processed locally in your browser.
The extension does not automatically upload recordings to MP3ToText or any other server.
The extension does not read page content or collect your browsing history.
The extension does not sell personal information or use advertising trackers.
No account is required to record, preview, or download audio.

sections.title: Scope
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy applies to the Voice & Tab Audio Recorder Chrome extension published by MP3ToText.
The extension records microphone audio, audio from the active browser tab, or both when you request it. It also lets you preview recordings and download them as WEBM, WAV, or MP3 files.
This policy covers the extension itself. If you visit or upload a file to https://mp3totext.io, the MP3ToText website Privacy Policy at https://mp3totext.io/privacy applies to that website activity.

sections.title: Audio and Data Handling
paragraphs: The extension accesses audio only after you select Voice, Tab Sound, or Voice + Tab.
Audio is captured and processed locally in Chrome. The extension does not transmit recordings to MP3ToText, an analytics provider, an advertising provider, or any other remote server.
The extension does not inspect or modify page content. It does not collect browsing history, website text, passwords, form entries, or the contents of other tabs.

Basic recorder information, such as the selected recording mode, recording timestamps, duration, file information, and format preferences, may be stored locally to provide recording, preview, and download functions.

sections.title: Permissions
paragraphs: The extension requests only the browser capabilities needed to record and save audio.
items: Microphone access is requested when you choose Voice or Voice + Tab. You can allow or block this access through Chrome.
tabCapture is used only after you choose Tab Sound or Voice + Tab to capture audio from the active browser tab.
offscreen is used to keep recording and local audio processing running after the extension popup closes.
downloads is used only when you choose to save a recording to your device.
storage is used for temporary recorder state and local preferences. It is not used to track your browsing activity.

sections.title: Local Storage and Retention
paragraphs: Recordings are stored in the extension's local IndexedDB storage so you can preview and download them. They are not stored in your Chrome account or synchronized across devices.

The most recent completed recording remains available locally until it is replaced, Chrome clears the extension's data, or the extension is uninstalled. A recording that is open in a preview page remains available while that page is open.

After a newer recording replaces an older one, the older recording is removed when it is no longer open in a preview page. Closing a preview page removes its recording when that recording is no longer the most recent one.
The local recording cache is limited to 500 MB. When storage is full, the extension removes eligible older temporary recordings first and may prevent a new recording until space is available.

sections.title: Downloads and Optional Transcription
paragraphs: Downloads begin only after you choose a file format. Chrome manages the save location and the downloaded file on your device.
The extension includes an optional link to MP3ToText for users who want to transcribe a recording. Selecting that option opens the MP3ToText website in a browser tab.
The extension does not automatically attach, upload, or transfer your recording when the website opens. You decide whether to select and upload a file.
If you upload a recording to MP3ToText, that upload and the resulting transcription are handled under the MP3ToText website Privacy Policy at https://mp3totext.io/privacy.

sections.title: Sharing, Sale, and Tracking
paragraphs: Because the extension does not transmit recordings or recorder activity to us, we do not receive that information through the extension.
items: We do not sell or rent extension user data.
We do not share recordings with advertisers or data brokers.
The extension does not contain advertising, analytics SDKs, or tracking pixels.
Our use of information received from Chrome APIs complies with the Chrome Web Store User Data Policy, including its Limited Use requirements.

sections.title: Your Controls
items: You can allow or block microphone access in Chrome's site settings for the extension.
You choose when a recording starts and stops.
You choose whether and where to download a recording.
You choose whether to open MP3ToText and upload a file for transcription.
You can remove locally stored extension data through Chrome or by uninstalling the extension.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Keeping recordings inside the browser reduces unnecessary data transfer. Access to extension data is controlled by Chrome's extension security model.

No method of local storage is completely secure. Anyone who can access your Chrome profile or device may be able to access locally stored information, so you should protect your device and browser profile.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: The extension is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children through the extension. If you believe a child has contacted us or provided information through a support request, email support@mp3totext.io.

paragraphs: We may update this policy when the extension's features or data practices change. We will publish the revised policy on this page and update the date shown above.
If an update materially changes how the extension handles user data, we will provide any additional notice required by applicable law or Chrome Web Store policy.
